summary: The candidate rejects non-JSON request bodies, requires the hub Origin and per-session CSRF token for authenticated password registration, gates replacement of an existing password on session age, and adds sibling-origin regression coverage that verifies the credential is unchanged. No introduced defects were found.

evidence: src/http.ts 55-61 now rejects any request whose Content-Type is not application/json, so text/plain CSRF bodies fail before any mutation.
src/passport.ts 645-656 requires the existing hub Origin plus the session's CSRF token for every authenticated /api/auth/password/register request.
src/passport.ts 660-670 refuses to replace an existing password unless the session was created within authConfig.hubTokenTtlMs.
src/handler_test.ts 4161-4237 and tests/worker_runtime.mjs 763-793 add same-site sibling-origin regressions and verify the original password still verifies.
